topics.title: Stern Discusses Clinton Scandal & SNL Premiere
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses the ongoing controversy surrounding President Bill Clinton’s affairs, including accusations related to numerous relationships. He also reports that Saturday Night Live has chosen Donald Trump as an alternative host for their season premiere due to his interest in the role and concerns about ratings.

topics.title: Lewinsky Investigation and Political Developments
topics.summary: Multiple sources discuss the ongoing investigation into President Clinton’s relationship with Monica Lewinsky, referencing Eddie Murphy and OJ Simpson while legal analysts like Greta Van Susteren analyze potential testimony. Concerns about political tactics surface alongside reports on unrelated events such as marijuana research, an IRA bombing in Northern Ireland, a teenager's alleged sexual conduct involving his sister, and DNA confirmation of a switched-at-birth case.

topics.title: DNA Tests, IKEA Secrets, and a Florida Man
topics.summary: A woman seeks DNA testing to determine if she was switched at birth while a Swedish furniture giant admits to Nazi sympathies and alcoholism in newly published records. A Florida man is arrested for attacking a pedestrian with his car after driving three miles with the victim stuck on his windshield, followed by discussions about prostitutes, Viagra in sauce, and a bizarre conversation regarding wearing panties to a movie.

topics.title: Fecal Matter and Presidential Scandals
topics.summary: A study reveals fecal matter contains numerous particles, particularly from sitting surfaces. Simultaneously, investigations continue into President Clinton’s affair with Monica Lewinsky, focusing on potential lies and DNA evidence collected from a dress. The conversation shifts to unrelated topics including William Peter Blatty's novel ‘The Exorcist,’ Pete Townsend’s band The Who, Jackie Robinson’s hot dog/donut commercial, and an incident involving Kenneth DeLeon who was hit by a car.

topics.title: Clinton Investigation Fallout
topics.summary: The President continues to face scrutiny over allegations related to Monica Lewinsky, with calls for his resignation persisting from figures like Jesse Jackson and Senator Daniel Patrick Moynihan. Investigations into Vice President Al Gore's fundraising activities alongside reports of Air National Guard pilots flying nude during a mission are also underway.

topics.title: Balloon Mishap and Prom Mom Plea
topics.summary: Steve Fawcett’s attempt to float around the world in a balloon ended with him crashing into the Coral Sea after being rescued by a yacht and subsequently transferred via tanker ship, eventually arriving in Australia. Simultaneously, Melissa Drexler pleaded guilty to aggravated manslaughter for killing her newborn son at prom; she faces up to 15 years imprisonment as part of a plea bargain.
